'''Bongo Bays''' were buildings where [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] got their [[bongo]]s repaired. The bays also sold bongo fuel that was made from fermented [[Bubble wort/Legends|bubble wort]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] took their donated [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|tribubble bongo]] from the Bongo Bay along with their navigator, the Gungan [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].
